relations: Surface motion continually reshapes the air-water boundary, spreading the dark jagged band and shifting the green wave face.
Turbulent water below the surface causes constantly moving refracted light patterns to shimmer across the dark-green wave face.
The bright sun in the upper-right sky persists, with small bright dots drifting near its glare as the waterline tilts.
The overall composition orientation holds steady, while the undulating waterline continually deforms between the sky and the underwater region.
caption: The video captures a half-submerged view at the surface of a wave, looking upward toward a bright sun blazing in the upper-right sky. Below the undulating waterline, turbulent refracted light shimmers across a dark-green wave face that rises on the left, while above it a pale blue sky with faint clouds meets a dark, jagged band running along the surface. Throughout, this boundary continually deforms: the green mass on the left shifts its silhouette, and the dark band spreads and reshapes as the waterline tilts and shifts. The underwater region churns with constantly moving caustic patterns, and small bright dots drift near the glare of the sun. The composition holds its overall orientation, with the sun and glare persisting in the upper-right corner. Surface motion continually reshapes the line between air and water. The process remains ongoing, with no clear start or finish visible.
